apiKey.label: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.help: Key for the official TypeSafe API (fallback: TYPESAFE_API_KEY env var).

backend.label: Jev backend
backend.help: Where Jev requests go. auto uses the first backend with a key: TypeSafe, then Vercel AI Gateway (AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY), then OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY).

jevRouter.label: Jev tool router
jevRouter.help: TypeSafe Jev skips LLM calls for simple browser and computer-use steps. Turning it on needs a gateway restart; turning it off and other edits apply immediately.

jevRouter.enabled.label: Enable Jev tool router
jevRouter.enabled.help: In browser and computer-use loops, let Jev run snapshots, clicks, and closed-argument use tools without an LLM call. Other steps call the model unchanged.

jevRouter.minConfidence.label: Jev min confidence
jevRouter.minConfidence.help: Jev decisions below this probability fall back to a normal model call (0-1).

jevRouter.maxConsecutiveDirectCalls.label: Jev max direct calls
jevRouter.maxConsecutiveDirectCalls.help: Maximum consecutive tool calls Jev may run without the model in one run.

jevRouter.timeoutMs.label: Jev timeout (ms)
jevRouter.timeoutMs.help: Per-request Jev timeout; on timeout the model is called normally.
